seoTitle: Moving in Jette with Gérard&Fils | 20+ years of experience
seoDesc: For your move in Jette, Gérard & Fils provides a team of professional removers who will handle every stage with care.
h1: Moving in Jette: local, secure and tailored service

intro.p: Gérard & Fils has been supporting you for over 30 years in all your moves in the capital region. Our qualified team, equipped with a modern fleet, offers complete services (packing, secure transport, installation) to meet all your needs. Whether you are staying in Brussels or considering a national or international move, we put our know-how at your service. We work throughout the capital, with the same expertise, in Uccle as well as in Jette.

sections.h: Why choose Gérard & Fils in Jette

body.p: A move in Jette comes with its share of challenges: urban access, parking, older buildings… At Gérard & Fils, we know these particularities well and adapt our approach for a smooth move. We take pride in combining local know-how with personalised support, to guarantee you a calm transition to your new home.

Every move is unique, which is why we adjust our service to your situation. Do you simply need secure transport, or would you rather also delegate the packing and handling of your furniture? We adapt our support accordingly. Our team carefully assesses the volume to be moved so as to plan the necessary equipment and assign the right number of removers, no more and no fewer.
To make your move easier, we offer various solutions according to your needs:

ul: External lift: for flats on hard-to-reach floors, we can arrange the installation of a furniture lift.
Professional packing: boxes, covers and protection suited to fragile items.
Insurance included: for complete peace of mind during transport.

body.p: Even if you are moving to Jette, our reputation does not stop there: we work with the same responsiveness and rigour in all the capital's municipalities. You benefit from a single point of contact, simplified administration for your move (parking reservation, permits) and detailed knowledge of the ground across Brussels.

sections.h: Contact us for a free quote in Jette

body.p: Moving to Jette? Tell us about your project and we will take care of the rest. A simple call is enough to get practical advice and a personalised, free, no-obligation estimate. We listen to your constraints and offer you a suitable solution, whether you are moving two streets away or to the other side of Brussels.
